output.summary: The event from November 18 to 19, 2022, featured a Dst minimum of -6 nT at 20:00 UTC on November 18, with southward Bz values below -5 nT for one hour. Solar wind speed was 380 km/s, and solar activity was moderate.

characteristics.statement: Dst minimum of -6 nT at 20:00 UTC on November 18, 2022.
Southward Bz values below -5 nT for one hour, with a minimum hourly Bz of -7.1 nT.
Solar wind speed was 380 km/s, and solar activity was moderate (mean F10.7 113 sfu).

possible_physical_interpretation.statement: Southward Bz is the main way solar wind energy enters the magnetosphere.

caveats: All values are hourly means in UTC; minute-level extremes are larger.
Solar wind and magnetic field values are shifted to the time they reach Earth (a delay of roughly 25 to 100 minutes depending on solar wind speed).
Bz is in GSM coordinates; negative Bz means southward.
Dst is provisional and may be revised by Kyoto.
